text:
Sam (AE): Quick help — Helios Health wants a 3-month dedicated POC with private deployment. They asked for 30% off list for the POC seats. Need deal desk + finance ok to move forward.

Maria (Sales Eng): Do we have a conversion commitment if they like it?

Sam (AE): They said likely convert to ~ $220k ARR on a 12-mo deployment. POC total list is $54,000 for 3 months. Prospect expects discounted quote to sign PO this week.

Emily (Solutions): Tech note: they require VPC + on-prem connector. There's an infra add-on ~$6k/month not in the current list. Also flagged KMS requirement.

DealDesk Bot: Policy: Standard POC discount cap = 25% on list price. Discounts >25% require Finance + VP approval and a documented conversion commitment. Attach SOW + security docs.

Sam (AE): SOW + SQ uploaded: https://drive.redwood.internal/helios-poc-sow.pdf  https://drive.redwood.internal/helios-sq.pdf

Chris (Finance): Paste the margin calc and proposed net TCV. Also need commission impact.

Sam (AE): Calc snippet:
```
List: $54,000
30% off -> -$16,200
Net POC rev: $37,800
Infra add-on (3mo): $18,000
Total net: $55,800
```
Commission: standard 8% on net.

Maria (Sales Eng): Without escalation we can offer 25%. If they need 30% we should ask for a 12-month committed conversion or a prepay option. Otherwise too risky.

Emily (Solutions): Also need legal to review private deployment SLA + SOC2 addendum. That can add ~3 business days.

Chris (Finance): I can approve up to 28% conditionally. Conditions: customer signs a 12-month renewal at >= $200k ARR OR prepays 9 months of expected usage. Need a one-pager with conversion KPIs and exec sponsor.

Sam (AE): Got it — pushing for 28% + conversion commitment. @Alex (Sales Ops) can you draft two quote variants (28% with renewal commit / 25% without)?

Alex (Sales Ops): On it — will produce both quotes and a redlined T&C for legal. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

DealDesk Bot: Request logged DD-2026-489. Chris (Finance) conditional approval: 28% with conversion clause. Assigned to Sales Ops for quote.

Maria (Sales Eng): I'll write the win narrative and include the security answers + exec sponsor details.

Chris (Finance): Conditional approval noted — final sign-off after contract contains the conversion term and prepay clause. :white_check_mark:
